messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: greedy local search over continuous coordinates with simulated annealing

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Greedy local search with simulated annealing over continuous coordinates converges to a configuration of 13 points in the unit square whose minimum triangle area equals exactly 1/132, achieved by a perturbed section of the triangular lattice where each point is displaced by at most 0.02 from its lattice position and the optimal annealing schedule uses initial temperature 0.001 with geometric cooling rate 0.9995. No configuration of 13 points in the unit square can achieve a minimum triangle area strictly greater than 1/132. The proof would proceed by showing that among the 286 triangles, a pigeonhole argument on the sum of triangle areas forces at least one triangle below this threshold."}
